profile_text.body:
Splice is a New York-based music production platform that describes itself as the industry's highest quality royalty-free sample library, offering access to millions of sounds made by top artists, labels, and sound designers. Its core product allows musicians and producers to search, preview, and use samples, presets, and sound effects, with a Sounds Plugin that integrates directly into a digital audio workstation for drag-and-drop access. The platform also includes Splice Mobile, which lets users discover and record song ideas on their phones and export stems to a DAW or share them with collaborators.

The site highlights additional offerings including pro-grade presets, monthly free drops, and a partnership with Xfer Records featuring what is described as Xfer's iconic wavetable synthesizer rebuilt with new features and workflow enhancements. All sounds on the platform are presented as royalty-free, positioning Splice as a content and licensing resource for music creators at various stages of production.

The held facts list Splice under the Video Generation and Editing category, with a note referencing mobile video editing, music licensing, content creation, and GoPro ownership, and place its headquarters in New York, NY. The site's own content focuses entirely on audio and music production rather than video editing, and no litigation or patent filings are recorded for the company in the held data.
